findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
examples: I'd still keep the Nurturer voice.
findings.reason: The linter sees the sentence alone as a paragraph. In the article it is the middle of three: "If that voice isn't there in you yet, borrow it from someone who's been safe for you." follows it, so it lands nothing.
